research.thaumictinkerer.dark_quartz.tex: Surround coal or charcoal with eight pieces of nether quartz to make smokey quartz. It can be worked into decorative blocks, pillars, stairs and slabs.
research.thaumictinkerer.spell_cloth.tex: Combine this cloth with one enchanted item in a crafting grid to remove its enchantments. Other item data is preserved. The cloth has 35 uses.
research.thaumictinkerer.cleansing_talis: Equip in a Curios necklace slot and sneak-use to activate. Every second it extinguishes fire or removes one harmful effect. Lasts for 100 cleanses.
research.thaumictinkerer.xp_talisman.tex: Equip in a Curios necklace slot. Sneak-use to toggle collection within 3 blocks, up to 1500 XP. Use with a glass bottle in your inventory to spend 10 XP and fill a Bottle o’ Enchanting.
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor.title: Ichor
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor.text: Ichor begins the KAMI material chain. Player kills of endermen in the End have a 1/32 chance to drop an Ender Shard; zombified piglins in the Nether have a 1/16 chance to drop a Nether Shard. Infuse these with a nether star, diamond and eye of ender.
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_cloth.tex: Weave enchanted fabric, ichor and diamonds into ichorcloth at an arcane workbench.
research.thaumictinkerer.ichorium.title: Ichorium
research.thaumictinkerer.ichorium.text: Combine thaumium, ichor and a diamond at an arcane workbench to create ichorium. It can be divided into nine nuggets and combined again.
research.thaumictinkerer.repairer.title: Thaumic Restorer
research.thaumictinkerer.repairer.text: Insert a damaged tool with a right-click; an empty hand retrieves it. Attach an essentia tube or jar to the facing side. Every half-second one Instrumentum repairs 8 durability, Fabrico 5, or Ordo 3. Hoppers can insert and remove tools. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.funnel.title: Essentia Funnel
research.thaumictinkerer.funnel.text: Right-click with an essentia jar to insert it; empty-hand right-click retrieves it. Place a hopper underneath, pointing into an essentia jar. The funnel drains one essentia every quarter-second into that jar. A jar directly underneath also works. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.mob_magnet.text: Supply redstone power: range is half the signal strength. The kinetic attractor moves item entities; the corporeal attractor moves living mobs. Sneak-right-click empty-handed to switch attraction/repulsion. Insert a filled Soul Mould to filter a species; sneak-click with wheat toggles adult/young animals. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.osmotic_enchant: Place six pillars within four blocks horizontally, each 2–12 blocks of obsidian or arcane stone topped with Nitor. Insert an item with right-click. Sneak-right-click empty-handed cycles every compatible catalogue enchantment; sneak-click with a stick cycles its level. An enchanted book also selects an enchantment. Right-click with a charged Thaumaturge wand to pay Vis and begin a five-second enchantment. Empty-hand right-click retrieves the item. Removing pillars interrupts the paid operation. TT enchantments require their own research. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.transvector_int: Sneak-right-click a target with the Transvector Binder, then right-click the interface with that binder. The target must be in this dimension and within 32 blocks. Item, fluid, energy and essentia automation attached to the interface reaches the target. Right-click the interface to open the target menu where one exists. Interfaces cannot link into other interfaces. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.transvector_dis: Bind a target with the Transvector Binder. On a redstone rising edge, exchange entities between the target block and the facing destination. Sneak-right-click empty-handed to switch to exchanging blocks and their block-entity contents. Sneak-click with a stick cycles destination distance 1–16. Bedrock, portals and unloaded chunks are excluded. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.remote_placer.t: Right-click to insert a stack of blocks. A redstone rising edge uses it at the facing position. Sneak-click with a stick cycles distance 1–16. Empty-hand right-click retrieves the stack. Sneak-click with a block copies its appearance without changing machine behavior. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.golem_connector: Bind a home position using the Transvector Binder. Right-click reports the health and position of your golems within 32 blocks. A redstone pulse sets those golems home to the bound position and directs them there. Modern Thaumaturge seals replace the old marker system. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.animation_table: Insert a tool or item by right-clicking. While redstone powered, the tablet uses it every second on the facing block. Sneak-right-click empty-handed switches to left-click, mining blocks or attacking mobs. Empty-hand right-click retrieves the held item. Actions run as an owner-identified fake player and consume tool durability and item counts. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.aspect_analyzer: Right-click with an item to report its live Thaumaturge aspect composition in chat. Empty-hand right-click reads the item inserted by automation. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.platform.title: Translucent Platforms
research.thaumictinkerer.platform.text: You can pass upward through this platform and stand on its top. Sneaking allows downward passage. Sneak-right-click with a block to copy that blocks appearance. The camouflaged utility block uses the same appearance controls. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.mobilizer.title: Levitational Locomotive
research.thaumictinkerer.mobilizer.text: Bind the locomotive to a relay within 32 blocks using the binder. Place a block on top: every five seconds the locomotive carries it one horizontal block, including saved machine inventories. Redstone stops movement. An obstacle reverses the direction. Sneak-right-click empty-handed also reverses it. Place the locomotive while looking horizontally. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.summon_tablet.t: Insert three mob aspects with right-click, or place them on nearby Thaumaturge pedestals within five blocks. Every 15 seconds an unpowered tablet consumes a matching trio and summons its mob. All three infused aspects instead remain bound to their first tablet and summon once per minute without consumption. Duplicate aspects require separate slots. Empty-hand right-click retrieves inserted aspects. See the individual mob-aspect entries for species and combinations. Sneak-click with a compass to cycle the six facing directions.
research.thaumictinkerer.infused_crops.t: Infuse wheat seeds with four matching primal crystals. Plant the seeds on farmland and harvest fully mature crops for seeds and infused grain. Grain is the crucible catalyst for its corresponding infused potion. Four cultivars exist: air, fire, earth and water.
research.thaumictinkerer.fire_aer.title: Air Infused Fire
research.thaumictinkerer.fire_aer.text: Place the fire to transmute adjacent blocks. It ages and spreads locally over transformable materials, so build a suitable containment. Wood becomes sand, leaves sandstone, ice glass, water cake and dirt sand.
research.thaumictinkerer.fire_ignis.text: Place the fire to transmute adjacent blocks. It ages and spreads locally over transformable materials, so build a suitable containment. Dirt becomes netherrack; sand and gravel soul sand; clay glowstone; ores nether quartz ore; lava water; crops nether wart.
research.thaumictinkerer.fire_terra.text: Place the fire to transmute adjacent blocks. It ages and spreads locally over transformable materials, so build a suitable containment. Sand, stone, cobblestone, logs, leaves, planks and glass become dirt; gravel becomes clay and nether bricks wood.
research.thaumictinkerer.fire_aqua.title: Water Infused Fire
research.thaumictinkerer.fire_aqua.text: Place the fire to transmute adjacent blocks. It ages and spreads locally over transformable materials, so build a suitable containment. Sand, soul sand and glowstone become ice; netherrack becomes snow and lava obsidian.
research.thaumictinkerer.fire_ordo.title: Order Infused Fire
research.thaumictinkerer.fire_ordo.text: Place the fire to transmute adjacent blocks. It ages and spreads locally over transformable materials, so build a suitable containment. Ores become the corresponding storage blocks, including deepslate ores and modern copper.
research.thaumictinkerer.fire_perditio.t: Place the fire to transmute adjacent blocks. It ages and spreads locally over transformable materials, so build a suitable containment. Other elemental fires become ordinary fire.
message.thaumictinkerer.device.bind_rang: Target must be in this dimension, within 32 blocks and different from this device.
message.thaumictinkerer.device.pillars: Six pillars are required: 2–12 obsidian or arcane-stone blocks topped with Nitor, within four blocks.
message.thaumictinkerer.device.vis: The wand does not hold enough Vis.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.ascent_: Increases jump velocity when not sneaking.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.slow_fa: Slows falls after 2.9 blocks. Sneak to fall normally.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.auto_sm: Instantly breaks wood and smelts its drops when a furnace recipe exists. Other block materials cannot be mined with this enchantment.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.disinte: Instantly destroys blocks with hardness at most 1.5, producing no drops or experience.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.vampiri: Heals the attacker by one heart per two enchantment levels of health points per hit.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.focused: Damage starts at half and grows as the same target is struck repeatedly.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.dispers: Repeated attacks against the same target deal reduced damage. Change targets to reset the penalty.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.final_s: A small chance to triple attack damage.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.shatter: Increases speed on blocks harder than 20; other blocks are slower to mine.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.shockwa: A fall of more than three blocks damages other living entities within ten blocks.
Mining in the same direction becomes faster. Turning more than 50 degrees incurs a speed penalty until the next block is broken.
research.thaumictinkerer.enchant.valianc: Increases damage while below half health.
spell.thaumictinkerer.smelt.name: Wand Focus: Efreet's Flame
spell.thaumictinkerer.flight.name: Wand Focus: Uprising
spell.thaumictinkerer.deflect.name: Wand Focus: Distortion
spell.thaumictinkerer.heal.name: Wand Focus: Mending
spell.thaumictinkerer.ender_chest.name: Wand Focus: Ender Rift
spell.thaumictinkerer.telekinesis.name: Wand Focus: Telekinesis
spell.thaumictinkerer.dislocation.name: Wand Focus: Dislocation
spell.thaumictinkerer.shadowbeam.name: Wand Focus: Shadowbeam
spell.thaumictinkerer.xp_drain.name: Wand Focus: Experience Drain
spell.thaumictinkerer.recall.name: Wand Focus: Celestial Recall
research.thaumictinkerer.gaseous_light.t: Use to release an invisible, persistent illuminating gas. It spreads up to four orthogonal blocks through open air and emits full light. One vial is consumed.
research.thaumictinkerer.gaseous_tenebra: Use to release an invisible, persistent gas that blocks light. It spreads up to four orthogonal blocks through open air. One vial is consumed.
research.thaumictinkerer.gas_remover.tex: Sneak-use to clear illuminating, shadow and temporary nitor gas from the original six-block cube around you.
research.thaumictinkerer.bright_nitor.te: Carry this item anywhere in your inventory to create temporary light at your head. The light blocks expire shortly after you move away.
research.thaumictinkerer.focus_smelt.tex: Socket this focus in a Thaumaturge wand. Hold use at a block for one second to smelt it in place when its furnace result is another block. Payment and pulses follow Thaumaturge’s channel system.
spell.thaumictinkerer.smelt.desc: Socket this focus in a Thaumaturge wand. Hold use at a block for one second to smelt it in place when its furnace result is another block. Payment and pulses follow Thaumaturge’s channel system.
research.thaumictinkerer.focus_flight.te: Socket in a Thaumaturge wand. Cast to surge in the direction you look; each cast resets fall distance. This is a burst of motion, so plan a safe landing.
spell.thaumictinkerer.flight.desc: Socket in a Thaumaturge wand. Cast to surge in the direction you look; each cast resets fall distance. This is a burst of motion, so plan a safe landing.
research.thaumictinkerer.focus_deflect.t: Hold the wand to repel ordinary hostile projectiles within four blocks. Reflected projectiles become yours; your own projectiles, experience bottles, fireballs and wither skulls are ignored.
spell.thaumictinkerer.deflect.desc: Hold the wand to repel ordinary hostile projectiles within four blocks. Reflected projectiles become yours; your own projectiles, experience bottles, fireballs and wither skulls are ignored.
research.thaumictinkerer.focus_heal.text: Hold use on a Thaumaturge wand to restore your health gradually, matching the original unmodified rate of one health point per thirty ticks.
spell.thaumictinkerer.heal.desc: Hold use on a Thaumaturge wand to restore your health gradually, matching the original unmodified rate of one health point per thirty ticks.
research.thaumictinkerer.focus_ender_che: Use the socketed wand to access your own Ender Chest from anywhere. The inventory is the same one used by vanilla Ender Chests.
spell.thaumictinkerer.ender_chest.desc: Use the socketed wand to access your own Ender Chest from anywhere. The inventory is the same one used by vanilla Ender Chests.
research.thaumictinkerer.focus_telekines: Hold use to gather dropped items around a point five blocks ahead. Sneak while channeling to draw the items to yourself.
spell.thaumictinkerer.telekinesis.desc: Hold use to gather dropped items around a point five blocks ahead. Sneak while channeling to draw the items to yourself.
research.thaumictinkerer.focus_dislocati: Use the wand on a block to carry it in the socketed focus, preserving its block state and block entity data. Use a block face to put it back. Ordinary blocks cost 5 Perditio, 5 Ordo and 1 Terra vis; block entities cost 25/25/5, and spawners cost 100/100/50. Placement costs no further vis. Unbreakable and fluid blocks are excluded, and break/place events are respected.
spell.thaumictinkerer.dislocation.desc: Use the wand on a block to carry it in the socketed focus, preserving its block state and block entity data. Use a block face to put it back. Ordinary blocks cost 5 Perditio, 5 Ordo and 1 Terra vis; block entities cost 25/25/5, and spawners cost 100/100/50. Placement costs no further vis. Unbreakable and fluid blocks are excluded, and break/place events are respected.
research.thaumictinkerer.focus_shadowbea: Channel a shadow beam that bounces off solid surfaces, up to eight reflections and forty-five blocks of total travel. It damages hostile living entities along its path and respects allied targets.
spell.thaumictinkerer.shadowbeam.desc: Channel a shadow beam that bounces off solid surfaces, up to eight reflections and forty-five blocks of total travel. It damages hostile living entities along its path and respects allied targets.
Channel through a Thaumaturge wand to exchange thirty experience points for up to five vis of the first primal aspect that has room. Each successful pulse pays XP; no vis is consumed.
spell.thaumictinkerer.xp_drain.desc: Channel through a Thaumaturge wand to exchange thirty experience points for up to five vis of the first primal aspect that has room. Each successful pulse pays XP; no vis is consumed.
research.thaumictinkerer.focus_recall.te: Charge a Thaumaturge wand for at least three seconds, then release to return to the first attuned Celestial Pearl in your hotbar. The destination must be an unlocked warp gate in the same dimension. Costs 120 vis before wand discounts.
spell.thaumictinkerer.recall.desc: Charge a Thaumaturge wand for at least three seconds, then release to return to the first attuned Celestial Pearl in your hotbar. The destination must be an unlocked warp gate in the same dimension. Costs 120 vis before wand discounts.
research.thaumictinkerer.blood_sword.tex: This 950-durability sword grants ten attack damage and 25% movement speed while held. Attacking costs two health; guarding replaces incoming nonmagical damage with three magic damage. Sneak-use toggles mob-aspect harvesting: supported mobs drop their three original aspects instead of ordinary loot. Nine aspects condense into one; eight condensed aspects can be infused into a ninth to make an infused aspect.
A thaumium helmet with the revealing component and five percent vis discount from Thaumaturge. It has 500 durability and repairs with thaumium. Its armor rendering uses Thaumaturge’s modern thaumium model.
research.thaumictinkerer.infused_inkwell: An 800-use set of scribing tools recognized by Thaumaturge research tables through its scribing_tools item tag. Surround it with eight ink sacs to refill it.
research.thaumictinkerer.share_book.text: Use a blank tome to record all your completed Thaumaturge research. Give it to another player to teach the recorded entries. The author can sneak-use it to refresh the snapshot. This intentionally enables the original survival sharing recipe.
research.thaumictinkerer.soul_mould.text: Use on a living nonplayer entity to record its registry type for mob magnets. Sneak-use clears the pattern.
research.thaumictinkerer.infused_potion_: Drink for three minutes of air imbuement. Your attacks cause the target to tumble in random directions every five ticks for one second. Brew the matching infused grain with five Auram and five Aer.

Drink for three minutes of fire imbuement. Your attacks mark the victim with the original lingering flame, refreshing six seconds of fire every five ticks for five minutes. Brew with infused fire grain, five Auram and five Ignis.

Drink for three minutes of earth imbuement. Your attacks raise a five-by-five wall between you and the target; the forcefield dissolves after sixty ticks. The wall only fills air and respects placement events.
Drink for three minutes of water imbuement. Lava in the four-block cube centered around you turns to obsidian, matching the original effect. Brew with infused water grain, five Auram and five Aqua.
message.thaumictinkerer.share_written: Your completed research has been recorded.
message.thaumictinkerer.share_read: The tome has shared its recorded research.
message.thaumictinkerer.recall_failed: No valid attuned pearl and unlocked gate were found in this dimension.
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_cap.title: Ichorium Wand Caps
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_cap.text: You have put Ichorium to its first ever use, by devising wand caps that give you a 20% discount on everything. Now you need to actually put this to any use and create a wand that can store more vis.
You have done it. By infusing a silverwood wand core with Ichorcloth, you managed to create the ultimate wand core.

This core holds an insane amount of 1000 of each type of vis. This will definitely make crafting expensive components a bit less stressful. Now the question lies, where will you get all the vis for this?
research.thaumictinkerer.ichorcloth_armo:
You have found how to weave Ichorcloth into clothing.

These new clothes are about as effective as mundane diamond armor, when it comes to protecting the wearer from damage. However, this cloth is completely unbreakable and will never sustain as much as a scratch.
You found a way of upgrading the Ichorcloth Cowl into a more powerful form.

First and foremost, the cowl doubles as goggles of revealing.
Second, the wearer is granted unlimited underwater breath as well as crystal clear underwater vision.
Lastly, if one wearing this cowl finds themselves without a full belly, the effects of health restoration will still apply, as if that was the case. Sneak-use the item to toggle its effects.
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_chest_gem:
You found a way of upgrading the Ichorcloth Robes into a more powerful form.

Starting off, by simply wearing these robes, the wearer is blessed with the power of eternal flight (wings that don't burn after 5 minutes included), as well as having all fall damage negated.
The robes also passively protect the wearer from any incoming simple projectiles, akin to the focus of Distortion. Sneak-use the item to toggle its effects.
You found a way of upgrading the Ichorcloth Leggings into a more powerful form.

These leggings are infused with the soul of fire.
For one, they cast a light around the holder, brighter even than that of Hyperenergetic Nitor. This light also expands to where the wearer is looking, akin to a flashlight, and prevails given the creator's existence in a much extended range.
Furthermore, these leggings not only provide fire resistance, but they convert any incoming fire damage into healing. Sneak-use the item to toggle its effects.
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_boots_gem:
You found a way of upgrading the Ichorcloth Boots into a more powerful form.

These boots allow for extremely smooth movement, akin to the Boots of the Traveller. The wearer's speed, jump height and jump reach all become magnified by wearing the boots, making movement a breeze. One can also walk on 1 high blocks as if they are slabs, this can be suppressed by sneaking.
Wearing the boots also induces a constant Haste II effect, turns any dirt below them into grass and negates all fall damage. Sneak-use the item to toggle its effects.
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_tools.tex:
You discovered how to create tools out of Ichorium. These tools are extremely powerful, even more so than diamond, furthermore, they never break.

For the creation of these tools, mundane sticks aren't enough, you decided to use Silverwood rods in replacement.
You awakened the real potential of an Ichorium Pickaxe. This pickaxe contains all the traits from the regular one, however, by shift right clicking on it, you can change what mode it's on.

On Block Mode (Green) it'll break blocks normally.

On Square Mode (Red) it'll break a 5x5 area around the original block broken. The area is offset, to allow for easy mining

On Line Mode (Blue)
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_shovel_ge:
You awakened the real potential of an Ichorium Shovel. This shovel contains all the traits from the regular one, however, by shift right clicking on it, you can change what mode it's on.

On Block Mode (Green) it'll break blocks normally.

On Square Mode (Red) it'll break a 5x5 area around the original block broken.

On Column Mode (Blue) it'll break a column of the same type of block as the one originally broken, 8 blocks above and below.
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_axe_gem.t:
You awakened the real potential of an Ichorium Axe. This axe contains all the traits from the regular one, however, by shift right clicking on it, you can change what mode it's on.

On Block Mode (Green) it'll break blocks normally.

On Square Mode (Red) it'll break a 5x5 area around the original block broken.

On Tree Mode (Blue) it'll break entire trees by simply cutting down one of their blocks.

This axe is also extremely proficient at cutting plant life.
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_sword_gem:
You awakened the real potential of an Ichorium Sword. This sword contains all the traits from the regular one, however, by shift right clicking on it, you can change what mode it's on.

On Single Mode (Green) it'll attack mobs normally.

On Area Mode (Red) it'll attack all mobs of the same type in a 3 block radius of the attacked one.

On Soul Mode (Blue) it'll deal less damage than normally, but every hit will bless the attacker with a Soul Heart.
[continued]
research.thaumictinkerer.cat_amulet.text:
It didn't take you long to come to the conclusion that you hated all those times a creeper snuck up on you.

To that end, using the knowledge you have that creepers run away from cats, you have devised an amulet that by simply being carried on you makes all creepers run in fear of your presence. Not only that, but they'll be petrified to the point of not gathering enough stoke to explode. Great. It must be worn in your amulet slot to take effect.
research.thaumictinkerer.ichor_pouch.tex: A 117-slot pouch that accepts ordinary items and prevents nested pouches. Use to open the current page; sneak-use to cycle between pages 1, 2 and 3 (54, 54 and 9 slots). Equip in a Curios belt slot when not in use.
Sneak-use a block to attune this ring while empty, then equip it in a Curios ring slot. It absorbs matching inventory blocks up to 2,147,483,647 while retaining and refilling one ordinary stack for building. Use a surface to place a stored block; sneak-use in the air to withdraw a stack. Blocks with custom components are not absorbed.
research.thaumictinkerer.placement_mirro: Sneak-use a block to select it. Sneak-use in the air cycles the square size from 3 to 11. Use a surface to build a plane along its face, consuming blocks from your inventory or Black Hole Rings. Block placement respects world borders and placement cancellation.
research.thaumictinkerer.protoclay.title: Protoclay
research.thaumictinkerer.protoclay.text:
You grew tired of having to constantly swap your tools.

This mixture will, by melding with the Ichorium, switch any Awakened Ichorium tools being held by the one used for the block being pointed at, case one tries to break it with the wrong tool.

As an example, trying to break a dirt block with an Awakened Ichorium Pickaxe while a Shovel is present elsewhere in the inventory will swap the two, and allow for fast disposal of the dirt block.
research.thaumictinkerer.warp_gate.title: Celestial Gateway
research.thaumictinkerer.warp_gate.text: Use an unattuned Celestial Pearl on a gateway to bind it. Sneak-use a bound pearl on another gateway to insert a destination (10 slots). Sneak-use an empty hand to cycle destination, then use to teleport. Sneak-use redstone to lock arrivals; sneak-use a pearl in the air to clear its attunement. Destinations must be in the same dimension and have clear space. Breaking a gateway drops its pearls.
message.thaumictinkerer.gate_unavailable: Destination unavailable: missing pearl or gateway, locked arrivals, or obstructed space.
